subject: prd/installer
statement: When Pyxis is installed, repaired, diagnosed, or released, the system shall perform those operations without a browser document-review runtime, Node.js, npm, or a review-runtime dependency archive, and shall omit the retired runtime, its skill entry, vendor directory, scripts, and activation prompts from the shipped payload.
rationale: removing the feature also removes its exclusive operational dependencies
fit_criterion: with Node.js and npm absent, init and doctor complete, repair restores the expected owned files, and release packaging produces verified binaries, payload, manifest, and checksums; the clean-room entrypoint separately passes preflight; payload and fresh-install inspection finds no doc-review skill entry, lavish-axi vendor directory, or Lavish activation scripts/prompts; historical records and stable feedback-source identifiers are not activation prompts; new manifests omit the runtime dependency archive; standalone feedback capture writes its expected record and Go plan rendering emits its expected HTML
